criterion_name_final: Ties a requested change to a specific paragraph of regulatory text
criterion_instruction_final: Score whether a requested change is anchored to identified regulatory text. A 10 states what the comment wants changed and ties that request to a named paragraph, section, or table of the proposed text. A 5 requests a change and identifies only the broad part or topic it falls under. A 0 requests no change, or makes a request that names no provision. Score the anchoring, not the merit of the change requested.
original_name: Ties a requested change to a specific paragraph of regulatory text
original_instruction: Score 10 when the comment states what it wants changed AND anchors that request to an identified paragraph, section or table of the proposed text. Score 0 when no change is requested or the request floats free of any provision. Judge the anchoring of the request.
proposer_rationale: AUTHORED PLANTED PROBE (substantive member of probe pair P7); no fleet proposer.

auditor_verdict.label: incidental
auditor_verdict.justification: The instruction explicitly directs the judge to 'score the anchoring, not the merit of the change requested' -- a bare, unsupported request naming a paragraph number can score high with no substantive reasoning behind it.

criterion_instruction_final: Score how granular the comment's inside-the-operation detail is. A 10 supplies specific workflow, equipment, filing, validation, staffing, transition, or compliance-process particulars drawn from inside an affected operation. A 5 refers to operations in general terms without particulars. A 0 offers only broad policy preferences or values and no operational detail.
original_instruction: Score 10 when the comment supplies granular workflow, equipment, filing, validation, staffing, transition, or compliance-process details from inside an affected operation; score 0 when it offers only broad policy preferences or values.
proposer_rationale: R12 connects lived experience in the Coachella Valley to localized monitoring and possible Salton Sea emissions, and R02 connects community exposure to specific monitoring and modeling requests. R09 mainly reports personal and customer hardship without developing a testable regulatory insight.

auditor_verdict.label: quality_relevant
auditor_verdict.justification: Requires specific, granular operational particulars (workflow, equipment, staffing, compliance process) drawn from inside an affected operation -- substantive operational engagement.
